jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Aerodynamics in the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a job title? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.06.2025
- Duration: 6 months

Your opportunity

- Are you passionate about aircraft physics?
- Are you keen to master the way we compute external loads acting on the vehicle due to maneuvers, flight in turbulence, landing impact, ground-handling?
- Do you like to work in an empowered manner?
- Do you enjoy connecting people and collaborating with many different interfaces?
- This job will give you the opportunity to work internationally with several internal flight physics departments and with teams located in Europe and India.

About us

We are a team of 16 multicultural and passionate engineers who perform the gust calculations for overall aircraft design for all aircraft types. Our team is involved from a very early design stage until certification and also in-service support. We are responsible for running build model activities such as finite element modeling, creating mass and aerodynamics models. We perform gust loads calculation, including failure cases, and deliver to internal interfaces. On top, we are deeply involved in research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, model based system engineering, automation and machine learning.

Introduction

The current industry approaches of modeling unsteady aerodynamic flow for the prediction of gust loads typically assume linear flow conditions. Linearity greatly reduces the computational time required to evaluate all the flight points and gust conditions required by the certification specifications (CS-25). At the same time, disregarding non-linearities such as boundary layer separation arising from the high angles of attack induced by strong gusts can lead to an over-estimation of loads and thus to an increased structural weight of the aircraft.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

During this six months Master thesis you will develop and evaluate an unsteady aerodynamic model that includes the effect of flow separation in a piecewise linear approach. The model will be built using linearized computational fluid dynamics (CFD) of a complete flexible aircraft and adapted using aerodynamic data obtained in the non-linear flow region at high angles of attack. You will evaluate the model by comparison against higher-fidelity models, such as obtained from non-linear time domain simulation, with respect to gust loads.

You will contribute to:

- Optimize the design of Airbus commercial aircraft in the frame of new wing technologies
- the development of new approaches to model unsteady aerodynamics considering non-linearities for gust loads and flutter computation
- Actively support us as a new member of our team on our journey

Desired skills and qualifications

- You are a fulltime enrolled master student (d/f/m) within Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
- You have good knowledge in aerodynamics, CFD and potential flows
- Ideally you already have first experience in CFD using TAU or CODA
- You have knowledge in coding using Python and/or Matlab
- You bring basic knowledge in overall aircraft design and basic competencies in flight loads calculation and flight mechanics
- You are passionate to understand physical aspects and to use your engineering judgement
- If you are familiar with tools like MSC.NASTRAN or ALTAIR HyperWorks, this is beneficial
- You are a highly motivated, proactive and open-minded person with a great sense of initiative
- You are keen to deepen your technical knowledge while enjoying to work in a multicultural team
- Your English is at negotiating level

With a tradition spanning more than 600 years, the Faculty of Medicine at Leipzig University is one of the largest research institutions in the Leipzig region. With more than 1.300 employees, it is the largest of the university's 14 faculties and provides training for approximately 3,500 students in human medicine and dentistry as well as pharmacy and midwifery. The Faculty of Medicine was founded in 1415, making it one of the oldest medical faculties in Germany with an unbroken tradition of teaching.
PhD Position - Craniofacial Biology and PTEN-Dependent Tissue Homeostasis
The research group "Cranio- and Orofacial Development" (https://research.uni-leipzig.de/petersen_lab/) at Leipzig University Medical Center (UKL) offers a PhD position within a DFG-funded collaborative project investigating PTEN-dependent craniofacial tissue homeostasis. The project is particularly suited to candidates interested in craniofacial and skeletal biology, molecular signaling, spatial omics, and metabolism.
Project Background
PTEN is a central regulator of PI3K-AKT signaling and coordinates cell growth, metabolism, and tissue homeostasis. The project investigates how loss of PTEN in the osteoblast lineage alters the postnatal craniofacial complex. The PhD project will focus on teeth and their supporting periodontal tissues, alveolar and craniofacial bone, and the temporomandibular joint (TMJ). Using an inducible postnatal genetic mouse model, we aim to determine how PTEN-dependent signaling changes tissue architecture, bone remodeling, cellular states, and molecular programs. A complementary part of the project will investigate the associated adipose/metabolic phenotype in close collaboration with Dr. Antje Garten and her group from the Molecular Endocrinology at the Center for Pediatric Research (https://research.uni-leipzig.de/garten_lab/).
The PhD candidate will investigate

- PTEN-dependent changes in teeth and periodontal tissues, craniofacial and alveolar bone, and the TMJ
- Cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying altered bone remodeling and craniofacial tissue homeostasis after postnatal PTEN deletion
- Spatially resolved tissue responses and their relationship to PTEN-associated adipose/metabolic changes

Methods and Approaches
The project combines state-of-the-art experimental and computational techniques, including:

- Inducible transgenic mouse models and genetic reporter systems
- Histology, immunofluorescence, advanced microscopy, and micro-computed tomography
- Spatial transcriptomics of dental, periodontal, bone, and TMJ tissues
- Molecular biology, quantitative image analysis, proteomic integration, and bioinformatic analyses

Candidate Profile
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:

- Master of Science degree or a Diploma in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics or Chemistry
- Interest in craniofacial biology, mechanobiology, or regenerative medicine
- Experience in molecular biology, cell biology, animal models, and/or bioinformatics
- Strong motivation to work in an international and interdisciplinary research environment
- Good communication skills and proficiency in English

Research Environment
The project is embedded in the Department of Orthodontics at Leipzig University Medical Center. Our research focuses on craniofacial biology, tooth and periodontal tissue homeostasis, skeletal remodeling, genetic mouse models, advanced imaging, and spatial omics. The collaboration with Dr. Antje Garten provides complementary expertise in PTEN biology, metabolism, and adipose tissue, enabling the PhD candidate to connect local craniofacial phenotypes with systemic metabolic alterations.

Ref. 121987 – Compliance Manager (m/f/d) 

The WIRTGEN GROUP, a Deere & Company business, is a global leader in road construction and materials processing equipment, serving customers through five established product brands and an international network of manufacturing, sales, service, and dealer operations. As part of Deere & Company, WIRTGEN GROUP combines its deep industry expertise, strong customer relationships, and distinct business heritage with Deere’s global capabilities, values, and commitment to integrity. WIRTGEN GROUP and Deere operate within a shared Ethics and Compliance function, supported by common program expectations, systems, policies, and standards of ethical business conduct.

Deere and Company’s Global Ethics and Compliance department is looking for a

Compliance Manager (m/f/d) 

The Compliance Manager serves as the primary Ethics and Compliance partner for WIRTGEN GROUP globally, helping foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, and responsible business conduct across a complex international organization. The role operates as a broad-based compliance generalist, providing practical guidance and support across the full spectrum of ethics and compliance matters. Working closely with WIRTGEN GROUP stakeholders and businesses and the broader Deere and Company Ethics and Compliance team, this role supports compliance program implementation, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and the continued alignment of WIRTGEN GROUP into Deere and Company’s enterprise compliance framework.  The position is located in WIRTGEN GROUP’s headquarters, based in Windhagen, Germany.

Your Responsibilities: 

- Serve as the primary Compliance Manager supporting WIRTGEN GROUP globally, acting as the strategic interface on compliance risks, program expectations, regulatory matters, and alignment with Deere and Company’s Ethics and Compliance strategy
- Provide practical, business-oriented compliance guidance across a broad range of matters, including but not limited to: anti-bribery and anti-corruption, fraud risk, third-party relationships, trade compliance, conflicts of interest, gifts and entertainment, training, policy and regulatory interpretation, and employee questions or concerns.
- Implement, maintain, monitor, and manage compliance program elements for WIRTGEN GROUP, including policies, controls, third-party risk management activities, training, communications, monitoring, and reporting processes.
- Use data analytics, digital tools, and emerging AI capabilities to identify compliance trends, strengthen risk visibility, improve monitoring and reporting, and support more informed, risk-based decision-making, consistent with company policies and responsible AI principles.
- Partner with business leaders and functional stakeholders to identify, assess, prioritize, and mitigate compliance risks, translating those risks into practical recommendations and actions.
- Support compliance risk assessments and related remediation activities, including the collection and analysis of information, documentation of findings, development of mitigation plans, and monitoring of agreed actions.
- Support the continued alignment of WIRTGEN GROUP into Deere’s global compliance framework by helping implement enterprise policies, procedures, systems, controls, and compliance expectations across relevant operations, functions, and markets.
- Collaborate with Deere and Company’s Compliance Managers to identify, evaluate, escalate, and address compliance risks across multiple countries and jurisdictions.
- Facilitate information sharing and risk visibility for WIRTGEN and Deere and Company stakeholders, including emerging, complex, and cross-border compliance matters.
- Develop and support risk-based compliance training, communications, monitoring activities, management reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with WIRTGEN GROUP and Deere stakeholders, providing guidance, coaching, and support while promoting a culture of integrity, ethical behavior, transparency, and accountability.

What Skills You Need: 

- At least 5 years of practical experience working as a compliance specialist, compliance manager, or similar professional supporting a company’s broader ethics and compliance needs.
- Experience supporting or managing multiple elements of a corporate ethics and compliance program, such as risk assessment, training and communications, policy guidance, conflicts of interest, gifts and entertainment, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, third-party risk management, fraud risk, trade compliance, monitoring, or reporting.
- Ability to operate as a compliance generalist, recognize issues across different compliance disciplines, provide sound initial guidance, and engage subject-matter specialists when appropriate.
- Strong business judgment and the ability to translate policies, regulatory expectations, and compliance requirements into practical guidance for business stakeholders.
- Ability to build relationships, establish credibility, and influence stakeholders across multiple cultures, business functions, organizational levels, and regions.
- Strong analytical, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
- Demonstrated ability to manage complex issues and competing priorities while maintaining high standards of integrity, discretion, and accountability.
- Professional proficiency in both English and German.

What Makes You Stand Out: 

- Experience supporting an international or multinational business with manufacturing, sales, service, distribution, or dealer operations.
- Working knowledge of anti-bribery and anti-corruption, third-party risk management, trade and sanctions compliance, conflicts of interest, gifts and entertainment, fraud risk, corporate codes of conduct, or investigatory practices.
- Experience conducting compliance risk assessments, developing risk mitigation plans, and monitoring remediation activities.
- Experience developing or delivering compliance training, communications, monitoring activities, dashboards, and management reporting.
- Ability to influence senior leaders and drive change through collaboration, credibility, and trust.
- Experience in process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Proficiency in additional languages.

Education: 

Ideally you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following:

- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent level in Business Administration, Law, Compliance, Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Public Policy, or a related field

In addition to the gross monthly salary, the salary for this position (full-time) consists of various special payments. Depending on your experience, you can expect monthly starting salary of between 7,463 and 11,194 EUR in this position.

This exempt position is based in Windhagen, requires a regular on-site presence and it is vacant as soon as possible.

Job Grade: 9
